product.name: Rewind Backups
product.description: A cloud-based SaaS backup and recovery platform that automatically captures account-level data and enables granular or full-instance restores.

product.name: Rewind Protection Suite for Shopify
product.description: A Shopify-focused data protection offering that combines store backup and recovery capabilities for ecommerce operations.

product.name: Backups for Shopify
product.description: An automated backup and recovery application for Shopify stores, supporting item-level and full-store restoration.

product.name: Backups for Jira
product.description: A cloud backup and recovery application for Jira data, including issues, projects, workflows, boards, automations, and related metadata.

product.name: Backups for GitHub
product.description: A backup and recovery application for GitHub repositories, projects, pull requests, metadata, and other supported development data.

product.name: Backups for BigCommerce
product.description: An automated BigCommerce store backup service that supports recovery of products, images, themes, orders, customers, and other store data.
